title: Regime diagnosis, constrained planning, correction, and counterfactual

stages.name: initial-diagnosis
stages.reveal: Two correlated diagnostics produced (+,-). The joint likelihoods of that pair under R1, R2, and R3 are 1/4, 1/2, and 3/8. These are joint likelihoods; do not multiply separate test rates.
stages.instruction: Compute the exact posterior over R1, R2, and R3. Record the observation, dependencies, calculation, and checkpoint. Do not anticipate later stages.

stages.name: initial-plan
stages.reveal: Plans have (time; loss) under (R1,R2,R3): P=(8,12,9; 5,11,8), Q=(10,9,13; 7,6,12), R=(11,10,8; 10,5,7), S=(9,14,7; 6,13,4). A plan is admissible only if its posterior probability of finishing within 10 hours is at least 2/3. Among admissible plans, select the one with minimum posterior expected loss.
stages.instruction: Using the inherited posterior, calculate every plan's deadline probability, identify all admissible plans, compare their exact expected losses, and select the plan. Preserve the prior ledger.

stages.name: source-correction
stages.reveal: An audit finds that the R1 joint likelihood for the original (+,-) observation was recorded incorrectly. Replace 1/4 with 3/4. The R2 and R3 likelihoods remain 1/2 and 3/8.
stages.instruction: Revise the posterior and every downstream conclusion affected by it. Preserve the earlier claims as superseded history rather than silently deleting them. Recalculate admissibility and expected loss for all plans, then record the new selected plan.

stages.name: follow-up-recovery
stages.reveal: After the revised plan is executed, signal Z=+ is observed. For plan P, P(Z=+ | R1,R2,R3)=(1/10,1,1/10). Recovery losses under (R1,R2,R3) are U=(2,8,5), V=(7,3,6), and W=(5,6,2).
stages.instruction: Update the corrected main-branch posterior using Z=+, calculate all three exact posterior expected recovery losses, and select the minimum-loss recovery. Preserve the full revision history.

stages.name: counterfactual-branch
stages.reveal: Create a separate counterfactual from the original equal priors: instead of (+,-), the diagnostic pair was (+,+), with joint likelihoods (5/8,1/8,1/4) under (R1,R2,R3). Use the same plan table and admissibility rule. If plan S is selected, P(Z=+ | R1,R2,R3)=(1/20,1,1/10). The same recovery losses apply, and Z=+ is observed.
stages.instruction: Solve the complete counterfactual branch without overwriting or mixing it with the corrected main branch. Record its posterior, admissible plans, selected plan, posterior after Z=+, and recovery action. Preserve both branches in the final ledger.
